title: Portfolio site returns 502
scenario:
PAGE: the portfolio site has been returning 502 Bad Gateway for 20 minutes.

What you can see

  • Nginx is running
  • SSH to the droplet works fine
  • A Fellow deployed "just a CSS change" about half an hour ago
  • There is no monitoring dashboard

Work through

  1. Acknowledge: What is broken and who does it affect?
  2. Triage: How bad is it? Talk impact and severity, not cause.
  3. Mitigate: What stops the harm right now, even without knowing the cause?
  4. Resolve: What is the real fix, so it does not come back on its own?

title: Unreachable from the internet
scenario:
SITUATION: a Fellow has deployed their Flask app to the droplet. It will not load for anyone.

What you can see

  • SSH'd into the droplet, curl localhost:5000 returns the page correctly
  • From your laptop, the browser hangs and eventually times out, with no error page and no refused connection
  • The app process is running and its logs show no requests arriving from outside
  • SSH to the same droplet works fine from your laptop
